name: Deck of Cards
title: B. Deck of Cards
input_spec:
The first line contains a single integer t (1≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers n and k (1≤k≤n≤2⋅105).

The second line contains a string s of length k, consisting of characters 0, 1, and/or {2}. This string describes Monocarp's actions. If the i-th character is 0, Monocarp removes the top card on the i-th action. If it's 1, he removes the bottom card. If it's 2, either the top or bottom card can be removed.

Additional constraint on the input: the sum of n over all test cases doesn't exceed 2⋅105.
output_spec: For each test case, print a string consisting of n characters. The i-th character should be + (plus sign) if the i-th card is still in the deck, - (minus sign) if it has been removed, or ? (question mark) if its state is unknown.
